package.name: reachy_mini_msgs
package.description: ROS 2 interfaces for a Reachy Mini driven as a native ROS component rather than through Pollen's HTTP daemon: MotionStatus (what the motion arbiter is doing and who owns it), BodyTarget (one streaming pose target), the GoTo and PlayRecordedMove actions, and the SetMotorMode / StopMove / SetOwner services. Units are metres and radians throughout and antennas are ordered [right, left], matching Pollen's own wire order so a message and a daemon payload never mean different things.
package.author: Pokamind AB
